title: The Lancashire Creamery Bread & Butter Pudding 10ml E-Liquid
description: The Lancashire Creamery’s Bread & Butter Pudding captures the comforting flavours of this classic British dessert, layering golden-baked Pastry with sweet, buttery Custard and a dusting of warming Spices. The inhale delivers rich, buttery notes balanced by the soft, mellow sweetness of Custard, while a subtle hint of Spices rounds out the flavour, leaving a warm and deeply satisfying finish. This nic salt e-liquid delivers a smooth, comfortable throat hit and rapid nicotine relief, making it ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping. The balanced 50% VG / 50% PG formula ensures a consistent flavour profile with discreet vapour production, perfect for use in pod systems, vape pens, and starter kits. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this 10ml e-liquid provides an option for vapers who prefer a lower, moderate, or higher nicotine intake. The Lancashire Creamery is a UK-based brand dedicated to creating indulgent dessert-inspired vape juices, offering luxurious, well-balanced flavours designed to satisfy sweet-toothed vapers.
